symptoms: Severe CNS symptoms (Na < 110 mmol/l): Seizures, coma, confusion, raised ICP

management_steps.details: 3% Hypertonic Saline: 2 mls/kg IV over 60 minutes to target serum Na = 120 mmol/l. Max increase 0.5 mmol/l/hr (max 12 mmol/l per 24 hours).

warnings: Do NOT exceed 0.5 mmol/l/hr or 12 mmol/l per 24h increase to avoid Central Pontine Myelinolysis (Osmotic Demyelination Syndrome).
